query:
-- Tabla para persistencia de planes de intervención personalizados
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intervention_plans (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  employee_id INT NOT NULL,
  cycle_id INT NOT NULL,
  retention_score DECIMAL(5,2) NOT NULL COMMENT 'Score de retención 0-100',
  risk_level ENUM('crítico', 'alto', 'medio', 'bajo') NOT NULL,
  critical_competencies_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  assigned_mentor_id INT NULL COMMENT 'ID del mentor asignado',
  course_recommendations JSON NULL COMMENT 'Array de cursos recomendados con prioridad',
  follow_up_plan JSON NULL COMMENT 'Plan de seguimiento trimestral Q1-Q3',
  status ENUM('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  progress_percentage INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 COMMENT 'Porcentaje de avance 0-100',
  created_by INT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  
  FOREIGN KEY (employee_id) REFERENCES employees(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (cycle_id) REFERENCES evaluation_360_cycles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (assigned_mentor_id) REFERENCES employees(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  INDEX idx_employee_cycle (employee_id, cycle_id),
  INDEX idx_risk_level (risk_level),
  INDEX idx_status (status),
  INDEX idx_created_at (created_at)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Planes de intervención personalizados para empleados en riesgo';

-- Tabla para seguimiento de actividades trimestrales
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intervention_activities (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  plan_id INT NOT NULL,
  quarter ENUM('Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3') NOT NULL,
  activity_description TEXT NOT NULL,
  expected_outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
  status ENUM('pending', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'skipped') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  completion_date TIMESTAMP NULL,
  notes TEXT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  
  FOREIGN KEY (plan_id) REFERENCES intervention_plans(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  
  INDEX idx_plan_quarter (plan_id, quarter),
  INDEX idx_status (status)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci COMMENT='Actividades trimestrales de planes de intervención';
